description: Remove the placed graphic from a frame and keep the frame itself – position, size, stroke, corners, object style and stacking order stay, for recycled layouts. Text is left untouched (use set_text with "" for that). Returns frame_id and graphics_removed (0 when the frame was empty already), plus removed_link_names. No undo for the removed graphic; the link on disk is not deleted. A graphic in an object anchored in a locked managed story is refused with invalid_state, details.code "story_locked".

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name: clear_frame_content
title: Remove a placed graphic
